name: tabpass
description: Open-source bridge that lets any AI agent read and use your Chrome tabs over MCP. By Migma.

scripts.setup: yarn --cwd relay install && yarn --cwd extension install && yarn --cwd e2e install
scripts.build: yarn --cwd relay build && yarn --cwd extension build
scripts.test: yarn --cwd relay test && yarn --cwd relay typecheck && yarn --cwd extension typecheck
scripts.test:e2e: yarn --cwd relay build && yarn --cwd extension build:dev && cd e2e && xvfb-run -a node run.mjs
